commands.title: Edit an LDtk room with semantic operations
commands.inputs: LDtk world or authored operation spec.
commands.outputs: Validation, query results, or transactional edits.
commands.mutation: Help and queries read only. Explicit edit operations write worlds.
commands.build: No Cargo build. Use the owner Python environment.

commands.title: Propose an LDtk tileset retarget
commands.inputs: LDtk worlds and a selected published sprite image.
commands.outputs: Unified diff with image-based coordinate conversion.
commands.mutation: Default writes a proposal. --apply writes changed worlds.
commands.build: No Cargo build. Retarget needs an existing selected sprite publication.
